meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Azure 配额确保资源可用
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure quotas to ensure resource availability

howto.what: 装好后,Claude 能通过 Azure CLI 查询订阅的配额与用量,给出各区域、各资源提供方的剩余容量,并在需要时提交配额提升申请;查询前会先安装 quota 扩展。
howto.when: 当你问到配额、服务限制、当前用量等,或要求规划部署、验证容量、选择区域时触发。

say.text: 查一下 eastus 区域的计算资源配额和用量。
say.note: 返回该区域的限额、已用量和剩余容量。

say.text: 我的订阅还剩多少 vCPU 配额?
申请把 standardDSv3Family 配额提高到 500。
say.note: 提交配额提升请求并查看审批状态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses the Azure CLI to query subscription quotas and usage, reporting available capacity per region and provider, and can submit quota-increase requests. It installs the quota extension before querying.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention quotas, service limits, current usage, or ask to plan a deployment, validate capacity, or choose a region.

say_en.text: Check compute quota and usage in eastus.
say_en.note: Returns limit, usage, and available capacity.

say_en.text: How many vCPUs are left in my subscription?

say_en.note: Submits a quota increase request and checks status.
